baseline_models.focus_anchor: قَيَّضْنَا لَهُمْ قُرَنَاءَ ... مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ
baseline_models.mechanism: Provisioned companions become attached interpretive partners: pairing supplies the bond, adornment positively recodes the whole forward-and-rear field, and the due word fixes the resulting loss.

activation_trace.role: The surface supplies assignment, while the exchange image makes the assigned companions matched counterparts in a consequential allotment.
The attached companion image supplies the durable social carrier of the recoding.
Making something appear good supplies the evaluative transformation performed by the companions.
The before-the-hands image supplies the forward, near, or impending part of the recoded field.
The behind image supplies the rearward or prior part, completing the companions' field of influence.
Fixed obligation supplies the transition from attractive recoding to an inescapably due consequence.
General diminution names the outcome of living inside the companions' recoded horizon.

changed_reading.before: Bad companions tempt people into unspecified wrongdoing.
changed_reading.after: Assigned companions form a social interpretation layer that makes both the approaching and inherited field look good until loss becomes due.

baseline_models.mechanism: The exchange image in ق ي ض, deeds attributed to hands, and commercial loss make adornment a false valuation process: acts are made to look profitable before the final account reveals depletion.

activation_trace.role: Matched exchange supplies a transactional frame for what is assigned in return.
Displayed goodness functions as a falsified valuation rather than a change in the underlying act.
The deeds-of-the-hands image allows the forward field to include what the subjects actively earn.
Commercial loss exposes the apparent gain as a transaction that consumes its capital.

changed_reading.before: The final clause merely labels the subjects losers.
changed_reading.after: The verse traces a mispriced transaction: companions beautify the subjects' own earning and its expected return, while the true account records capital loss.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فِي أُمَمٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنسِ
baseline_models.mechanism: Resemblance to an origin, companionship within a generation, and nations that have passed combine into social replication: the present cohort reproduces an older pattern across hidden and visible kinds.

activation_trace.role: Resemblance returning toward an origin supplies replication rather than a merely random assignment.
A generation joined in one time supplies the cohort scale of the replicated pattern.
The nation as a collective kind makes the consequence communal and recurrent.
The passing of an age supplies the historical relay from vanished cohorts to the present one.
Hidden beings extend the replicated social pattern beyond visible human association.
Visible humanity supplies the complementary public side of the cross-kind cohort.

changed_reading.before: Earlier nations are only precedents for the same punishment.
changed_reading.after: The verse depicts a replicating companionship pattern in which each cohort comes to resemble prior hidden and visible communities before sharing their loss.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first couples divine adornment with lamps and guarding; the focus repeats adornment but transfers its agency to companions and supplies no guard. Ornament therefore divides into illuminating protection and attractive exposure.

activation_trace.role: The focus anchor is the companions' act of displaying the field as good.
The same act of adornment supplies a controlled comparison with the adorned lower heaven.
Lamps make the earlier adornment disclose and orient rather than merely please.
Guarding joins true adornment to protection, exposing its absence from the companions' beautification.

structural_cues: 41:12 and 41:25 repeat the same adornment root with different agents and different accompanying functions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adornment-plus-lamps-plus-guarding at 41:12 and companion-made adornment at 41:25; I infer that the missing guard marks counterfeit illumination, while a live alternative is simple reuse of a neutral adornment verb.

changed_reading.after: The companions imitate a prior divine operation but detach beauty from illumination and protection, producing counterfeit guidance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Messengers had entered from the exact before-the-hands and behind channels later occupied by companion-made adornment. The focus can therefore be read as a counter-message system that recodes the same access lanes through which warning arrived.

activation_trace.role: The interval construction anchors the companions' activity in a field with two approach directions.
The forward and near approach is one half of the focus field.
The rearward approach completes the focus field.
Messenger and sending supply the warning-bearing traffic that used these directions.
The same interval construction establishes the exact phrasal recurrence.
The messengers' forward approach supplies one previously open warning lane.
Their rearward approach supplies the other previously open warning lane.

structural_cues: 41:14 and 41:25 share the full directional construction, but warning occupies it first and beautification later.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact directional recurrence with messengers in the first scene and companions in the second; I infer competitive occupation of message channels, while the live alternative is a broad idiom meaning comprehensive reach in both places.

changed_reading.before: The companions beautify past and future in a general temporal sense.
changed_reading.after: They counter-program the very approach lanes through which warning had reached the community, replacing reception with recoding.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah makes blindness preferred over guidance and later makes a conjectural model of God the cause of ruin. Companion adornment thus works by making a blinding model lovable and credible enough to be adopted, not by erasing agency.

activation_trace.role: Displayed attractiveness anchors the mechanism by which an option becomes preferable.
Gentle indication to the true path supplies the available alternative that was not absent.
Heart-attached preference supplies the voluntary uptake of the blinding option.
Blindness of insight names the perceptual result of that preference.
Conjectural imagining supplies the adopted explanatory model about divine knowledge.
An assumption whose outcome cannot be trusted becomes the explicit causal subject of the ruin.
Falling into destruction supplies the consequence generated by the preferred conjecture.

structural_cues: 41:17 grammatically places preference between supplied guidance and blindness.
41:22-23 repeats the subjects' conjecture and makes it what ruined them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies chosen blindness and a ruinous conjecture; I infer that companions furnish desirability and plausibility to that choice, while the live alternative is that they incite acts without shaping a full worldview.

changed_reading.before: Assigned companions overpower their subjects and cause loss.
changed_reading.after: They curate an attractive conjectural world that the subjects prefer and adopt, preserving responsibility within the social influence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately following instruction not to listen and to generate mixed noise gives the companions' beautification an operational form: a group can maintain its attractive account by blocking comprehension and flooding the channel.

activation_trace.role: Binding one party to another anchors the coordinated social machinery.
Hearing as understanding and compliance is the capacity the command seeks to disable.
Mixed vocal noise supplies the concrete interference tactic.
Overpowering force supplies the tactic's declared social objective.

structural_cues: 41:26 follows the focus directly and shifts from companion influence to a plural, coordinated anti-listening command.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, coordinated noise, blocked hearing, and a goal of dominance; I infer that this instantiates the companions' maintenance method, while the live alternative is a separate crowd tactic not identical with the assigned companions.

changed_reading.before: Beautification is private persuasion inside an individual's mind.
changed_reading.after: It is socially enforced attention control: companions preserve the attractive frame by preventing rival speech from becoming intelligible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later demand to see the two who misled them from jinn and humans retrospectively exposes the focus companions as directional agents, then reverses their hierarchy by placing the former guides underfoot.

activation_trace.role: Attached companions anchor the agents whose influence is later reassessed.
Departure from guidance explicitly names the companions' inferred directional effect.
Hidden beings repeat the first class named in the focus and make one source of misleading visible in retrospect.
Visible humanity repeats the second class and completes the paired source.
The literal feet enact a bodily reversal of who had stood as an orienting companion.
Physical lowering supplies the desired reversal of the former influence hierarchy.

structural_cues: 41:29 repeats the focus pair of jinn and humans and assigns them a misleading role.
The requested movement from influence to underfoot position reverses the relationship spatially.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same two classes and later calls two members of them misleaders; I infer retrospective identification with the focus companions, while a live alternative is that 41:29 denotes different leaders within the same broad classes.

changed_reading.before: The jinn-and-human phrase classifies earlier losing nations.
changed_reading.after: It also anticipates the sources of misleading companionship, whose apparent authority will be exposed and inverted.

context_deltas.mechanism: Angelic descent and declared protective alliance provide a positive counterpart to assigned companions. One relation beautifies a false horizon; the other speaks truth, removes anticipatory fear and retrospective grief, and spans worldly and later life.

activation_trace.role: The attached companion anchors the adverse relational regime.
Descending and arriving supplies the beneficent relation's movement toward its recipients.
The angels supply the positive relational agents contrasted with the focus companions.
Fear of an expected evil marks the forward-facing burden that the angelic message removes.
Grief's inner roughness marks the rear-facing burden that the angelic message removes.
Loving protective alliance supplies the alternative form of close accompaniment.

structural_cues: 41:30-31 places angelic speech, removal of fear and grief, and protective alliance together.
The alliance explicitly spans this life and the hereafter, matching the focus's broad temporal field without deceptive adornment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two close relational agencies with opposite speech effects; I infer rival companionship regimes, while the live alternative is that angelic allies are consolers rather than structural counterparts to quranāʾ.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes only the presence of corrupt associates.
changed_reading.after: It sits within a contest between two modes of accompaniment: one colonizes perception, while the other truthfully reorients past grief and future fear.

context_deltas.mechanism: An enemy can become an intimate ally through a better response, while satanic incitement corrupts the relation-between and can be met by refuge. This weakens a deterministic reading of companionship and recasts it as a relation that is formed, corrupted, transformed, or interrupted.

activation_trace.role: Binding one thing to another anchors companionship as a relation rather than an essence.
Pushing away harm supplies the action that changes the relational configuration.
The better response supplies the quality that drives the reversal.
The connection between parties is the medium being transformed.
Enmity supplies the relation's starting state.
Loving alliance supplies the transformed state.
Close kin-like intimacy intensifies the transformed bond.
Incitement that corrupts relations supplies a contrary process that manufactures hostile attachment.
Seeking protective refuge supplies an interruption rather than passive submission to that process.

structural_cues: 41:34 explicitly converts enmity into intimate alliance.
41:36 immediately names relation-corrupting incitement and prescribes refuge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reversible human relations and interruptible incitement; I infer that companion formation remains dynamic before the focus verdict fixes, while a live alternative is that the divinely assigned focus companions describe a later, already settled condition.

changed_reading.before: Once companions are assigned, their subjects are mechanically enclosed by them.
changed_reading.after: Companionship is a contested bond-forming process with available counter-actions, even though persistent uptake can culminate in a fixed verdict.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Book is declared inaccessible to falsehood from the exact before-and-behind directions that companions adorn. The attack therefore succeeds by decorating the recipients' surrounding frame, not by entering or altering the revelation itself.

activation_trace.role: Companion-made appearance anchors the alteration on the reception side.
Loss of truth and stability names the excluded content that cannot gain access to the Book.
The interval construction establishes the exact directional correspondence with the focus.
The forward approach is declared closed to falsehood at the textual object.
The rearward approach is likewise closed, completing the Book's directional immunity.
Tight, perfected construction supplies why the revelation resists ingress from either direction.

structural_cues: 41:42 repeats the complete focus direction formula while negating falsehood's access.
The focus assigns adornment to what surrounds the hearers, whereas 41:42 describes the Book itself.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies identical approach vectors with vulnerable recipients in one scene and an immune Book in the other; I infer displacement of attack onto reception, while the live alternative is that both formulas simply express temporal comprehensiveness.

changed_reading.before: Companions make false content compete directly with revelation.
changed_reading.after: Unable to penetrate the text, they beautify the hearers' total interpretive surround so that an intact revelation is received through a corrupted frame.

context_deltas.mechanism: A prior word elsewhere suspends immediate adjudication; in the focus the word becomes due. Together they make the word a governing term with temporal force that precedes, delays, and eventually matures into judgment.

activation_trace.role: Fixed entitlement anchors the moment when the governing word becomes enforceable.
Uttered saying supplies the focus term whose force is being reclassified.
A meaningful word or formulation supplies the prior governing term.
Precedence supplies the term's temporal priority over the dispute.
Decisive judgment supplies what the prior term postpones.
The interval between disputants supplies the legal field in which judgment would occur.

structural_cues: 41:45 explicitly makes a preceding word the condition preventing immediate judgment between disputants.
41:25 says the word has become due upon a recurrent cohort.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a prior word that delays judgment and a word that becomes due; I infer one legal-temporal logic of maturation, while the live alternative is that the two words denote distinct decrees without a shared mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The word coming due is an immediate condemnatory utterance.
changed_reading.after: It is the maturation of a prior governing sentence: companion-shaped choices accumulate until a deferred term becomes enforceable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Formerly invoked supports disappear, yet the subject constructs a future in which the Hour will not stand and even return will yield the best. This concretizes beautifying before and behind as a self-serving narrative that edits failed dependencies and anticipated outcomes.

activation_trace.role: What lies forward anchors the projected future being beautified.
What lies behind anchors the edited history of prior supports and outcomes.
The loss of formerly relied-on objects supplies the failed past that the narrative cannot sustain.
Calling and directing speech toward those supports identifies the prior dependency.
Temporal priority explicitly locates that dependency in the subject's before-now.
Conjecture supplies the unsupported forecast that the Hour will not occur.
The standing of the Hour supplies the future event that the beautified forecast denies.

structural_cues: 41:48 pairs vanished former dependencies with recognition that no escape remains.
41:50 voices a sequence of entitlement, denial of the Hour, and confidence in a favorable return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed prior supports and an explicitly self-favoring forecast; I infer these as the content of the focus's rearward and forward beautification, while the live alternative is an unassisted human rationalization rather than companion-authored narration.

changed_reading.before: Before and behind are an abstract expression for everything around the subjects.
changed_reading.after: They are a manipulable life story: companions sanitize failed dependencies behind and guarantee favorable consequences ahead.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins a heated ownership mark to beautification rather than the ordinary assignment sense of ق ي ض; it remains anchored in the focus roots and their sequence, but downstream prose should present it only as a material counter-image, not as the lexical meaning of the clause.

activation_trace.role: A heated impressed mark supplies a material image of assignment leaving an identifying scar.
Applied ornament supplies the attractive surface that can conceal the mark's injurious character.

changed_reading.before: The companions add an attractive covering to the subjects' world.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the attractive covering doubles as a brand: what looks like ornament records the attachment that will identify its bearers with the losing cohort.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it spatially nests the companions' local perceptual surround inside divine all-encompassment; it remains valid through the focus's two-sided field and 41:53-54's horizons, disclosure, and encompassing, but prose should qualify the nesting as a reader-supplied spatial analogy.

activation_trace.role: The interval between directions supplies the subjects' apparently total local surround.
Far horizons expand the evidence field beyond the companions' near framing.
Emergence into clarity supplies a breach in the beautified appearance.
Complete encompassing in knowledge supplies the larger enclosure within which the local false frame remains visible.

changed_reading.before: The companions successfully make the subjects' whole horizon self-sealing.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their frame is only a nested pseudo-enclosure: signs can clarify beyond it because the apparently total field is itself encompassed and witnessed.

strongest_changes: The exact 41:14 recurrence turns front-and-behind from generic totality into message lanes first used by messengers and later counter-programmed by companions.
The 41:42 recurrence relocates corruption from the immune Book to the recipients' surrounding interpretive frame.
41:17 and 41:22-23 show that adornment works through preferred blindness and adopted conjecture, preserving agency.
41:30-36 reveals rival and reversible companionship rather than a single mechanically fixed social bond.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah repetition repeatedly reuses the focus's adornment, companionship, and directional grammar with changed agents: guarded lamps, messengers, noise-makers, exposed misleaders, angelic allies, and an immune Book.
remaining_uncertainties: Before and behind can remain a broad temporal idiom even where the directional recurrences support message-channel and reception models.
The later jinn-and-human misleaders plausibly identify the focus companions, but the packet does not force numerical identity.
The exchange, branding, and nested-enclosure images are branch-driven exploratory mechanisms rather than ordinary lexical glosses.
